class.brief_description: Polygon2DCanvas Concrete 2D interactive polygon canvas built on `GeometryCanvas2DBase`.
class.description: Polygon2DCanvas Concrete 2D interactive polygon canvas built on `GeometryCanvas2DBase`. Renders ear-clipped polygon triangulation, centroid marker, convex hull overlay, live offset contour preview (`compute_offset_polygon`), and supports double-click vertex insertion and right-click vertex deletion with Undo/Redo. Part of IdeamGeometry (2D/3D polygons, Voronoi diagrams, SDF grids, and tensor fields).
